Changelog

What changed in the course and when. Every lesson also shows the date it was last reviewed. Updates are free to buyers.

2026-11-23 · Checkpoint 35

  • New: a local reference lab kit with 18 seeded flaws from lessons 14 and 22 to 28, a reference control and an unsafe baseline for each.
  • New: OWASP Agentic Top 10 (ASI01 to ASI10) mapped to the course lessons, in lesson 4.
  • New: MCP is stateless in the 2026-07-28 specification, so state-handle hijacking replaces session hijacking, and a confused-deputy note for proxy servers (lesson 6).
  • New: sender-constrained tokens (DPoP, RFC 9449) and token exchange (RFC 8693) (lesson 7).
  • New: approval binding to exact arguments, and the time-of-check to time-of-use gap (lesson 14).
  • Fixed: the course page now describes the real 28-section lab and the five real health checks, and no longer claims the health check judges your design.
  • Fixed: the how-to-buy answer now describes the real bank-deposit and receipt flow.
  • Added: a last-reviewed date on every lesson and this changelog.

2026-11-21 · Lessons 21 to 28

  • Frontier research module and the protocols, skills and identity module added (lessons 21 to 28).
